# ARCH-20: A flag a mode holds true must still be true when the mode ends

- While a mode holds a validity flag true, the evidence the flag otherwise needs goes stale, so the flag drops the moment the mode ends. Keep the evidence current while the mode runs, or refresh it as the mode ends.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
